inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Monitoring Cross-Tenant Abuse by Threat Actors

properties.description:
This rule detects suspicious or unauthorized changes to Cross-Tenant Access Settings in Entra ID (Azure AD) within the last 1 hour.

Cross-Tenant Access Settings control how external organizations can collaborate (B2B/B2B direct connect). If an attacker modifies these settings, they could:

Add a malicious partner tenant for persistence.

Weaken default cross-tenant restrictions.

Update existing partner access to expand privileges or bypass controls.

By monitoring these critical events in AuditLogs, the rule helps SOC teams detect and respond to tenant abuse attempts by threat actors.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Monitoring Cross-Tenant Abuse by Threat Actors
properties.query:
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where Category == "CrossTenantAccessSettings"
| where OperationName == "Update the company default cross-tenant access setting" or 
OperationName == "Add a partner to cross-tenant access setting" or
OperationName == "Update a partner cross-tenant access setting"
